# Xyvot

> Xyvot is the instant commerce platform connecting local shops with customers.
> Groceries and essentials delivered in 15 minutes.

Xyvot is a quick-commerce platform based in India. It operates three sides of a marketplace:

- **Customers** shop groceries and daily essentials from neighbourhood stores via https://shop.xyvot.com with 15-minute express delivery, live order tracking, and WhatsApp OTP login.
- **Businesses** run their entire operation on the Xyvot merchant platform via https://business.xyvot.com — online storefront, inventory management, POS billing, GST-ready invoicing, and automatic rider dispatch.
- **Delivery partners** earn by delivering nearby orders via https://rider.xyvot.com with flexible shifts and transparent per-delivery earnings.

## Key facts

- Company: Xyvot
- Website: https://www.xyvot.com
- Marketplace: https://shop.xyvot.com
- Business platform: https://business.xyvot.com
- Rider app: https://rider.xyvot.com
- Category: Quick commerce / instant delivery / hyperlocal marketplace
- Region: India
- Delivery promise: ~15 minutes for groceries and essentials
